acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec defines map_plan input/output, step resolution, shared setup, session and navigation optimisation rules, data handoff, byte caps, fail-closed UNMAPPED/STALE handling and the authority limit, with numbered requirements and rollback.
On the issue-657 fixture map, a multi-step plain-language request yields a deterministic typed plan under its byte cap, reusing one session per app and skipping redundant navigation.
A step with no mapped flow or with STALE anchors is reported UNMAPPED/STALE with the exploration needed; the planner never invents a path or reports full confidence.
Per-step confirmation reflects receipt-bound verification status (issue 658) and never upgrades candidate research into behavioural truth.
A drafted spec skeleton has one test.step per action with the expected outcome assertion named; available from the CLI and the corpus MCP.
body: Owner request https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/660 (2026-10-07): 'test this edge case where you do 5 things in different parts of the website in a row, and using this corpus you know exactly how to do it in the most optimal way possible'. Adopter workaround plans each step to a researched flow, one shared data setup (proven registry scenario, API clients for remaining entities), one browser session per app, direct-URL navigation without redundant re-navigation, per-step confirmed methods/selectors/asserts, data handoff between steps, and UNMAPPED gaps; it drafts a Playwright spec with one test.step per action. Ask: (1) map_plan(steps[]) over the issue-657 map with byte caps and typed per-step results (flow, screen, navigation, methods[confirmed], selectors[strength,verified], asserts, produces/consumes, confidence, unmapped), also via CLI; (2) confirmation from receipts (issue 658); (3) fail-closed composition: UNMAPPED or STALE steps are named with the exploration needed, never an invented path; (4) test-validity on the composed test's receipt checks each test.step asserts an outcome and cleanup ran; (5) stored plans anchored for impact re-selection (needs issue 659); (6) learning loop feeding confirmations and notes (issue 655) back to the map.
